cohort: The study included 56 patients treated for adnexal torsion (AT) and 168 matched control patients (CG) who underwent digestive or urological surgery, all aged less than 43 years and desiring post-operative pregnancy.
finding: The study found no significant difference in post-operative pregnancy rates, time to pregnancy, or occurrence of early menopause between patients treated for adnexal torsion and a control group.
